provenance.note: Census Geocoder Exact match: 4009 SHERWOOD LN, HOUSTON, TX, 77092

inspection_summary.note: Texas HHSC inspections, report investigations and assessments since October 2017, updated daily.

occurrences.finding: Director Annual Training 30 Hours Required: The director has not completed the required 30 clock hours of training during the annual period from 1/17/2025 to 1/17/2026.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Director Annual Training 30 Hours Required (26 TAC §746.1311(a))

occurrences.finding: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment: CCR observed that the acoustic ceiling in the pool house was damaged, with sections missing and cracks present.        Correction made: The operation repaired the glass sliding door in the pool house.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment (26 TAC §746.3407)

occurrences.finding: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months: The operation's fire inspection has not been completed since 8/12/2025.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months (26 TAC §746.5101(a))

occurrences.finding: Installation and Maintenance of Loose-fill Surfacing - Six Inches if Equipment 5 Ft or Less: The operation has a play structure with a slide that is under five feet in height; however, the loose fill beneath it measures less than 6 inches deep.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Installation and Maintenance of Loose-fill Surfacing - Six Inches if Equipment 5 Ft or Less (26 TAC §746.4907(a)(1))

occurrences.finding: AP Required Admission Information - Child able to swim competently: CCR reviewed six children's admission files and found that the operation does not include a question on the form regarding whether a child can swim competently.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Required Admission Information - Child able to swim competently (26 TAC §746.605(16)(A))

occurrences.finding: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment: CCR observed that the acoustic ceiling in the pool house was missing, cracked, and sagging. Additionally, the glass sliding door in the pool house was broken, preventing it from closing properly.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment (26 TAC §746.3407)

occurrences.finding: Installation and Maintenance of Loose-fill Surfacing - Nine Inches if Equipment Greater Than 5 Ft.: The operation has a play structure with a slide exceeding five feet in height; however, the loose fill beneath it measures less than 9 inches deep.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Installation and Maintenance of Loose-fill Surfacing - Nine Inches if Equipment Greater Than 5 Ft. (26 TAC §746.4907(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: AP Required Admission Information - Child requires a personal flotation device: CCR reviewed six children's admission files and found that the operation does not include a question on the form regarding whether a child is required to wear a personal flotation device.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Required Admission Information - Child requires a personal flotation device (26 TAC §746.605(16)(B))

occurrences.finding: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Employees' Attendance: The director time sheets were not available during the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Employees' Attendance (26 TAC §746.801(5))

occurrences.finding: Swimming Pools - Chemicals and Pumps Inaccessible to Children: CCR observed  pool chemicals and the pump were not properly stored and were accessible to children during swimming lessons.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Swimming Pools - Chemicals and Pumps Inaccessible to Children (26 TAC §746.5001(4))

occurrences.finding: Director Annual Training 30 Hours Required: The director has not completed the required 30 clock hours of training during the annual period from 1/17/2025 to 1/17/2026.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Director Annual Training 30 Hours Required (26 TAC §746.1311(a))

occurrences.finding: Food Allergy Emergency Plan Signed by Parents and Health Care Professional: 1 child with a diagnosed food allergy needs an updated food allergy emergency plan, signed by both the parent and medical professional, along with the prescribed medication.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Food Allergy Emergency Plan Signed by Parents and Health Care Professional (26 TAC §746.3819)

occurrences.finding: Safety - Play Materials and Equipment Safe: Two children's play toys present on the playground had sharp and jagged edges. Note: this was corrected at inspection when the director removed them.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Play Materials and Equipment Safe (26 TAC §746.3701(5))

occurrences.finding: Installation and Maintenance of Loose-fill Surfacing - Posts Marked to Proper Depth: 2 composite play structures on the playground are missing  post markings that indicates the depth of the loose fill.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Installation and Maintenance of Loose-fill Surfacing - Posts Marked to Proper Depth (26 TAC §746.4907(c))

occurrences.finding: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Fire Inspection Report, Including Written Approval for Above/Below Ground Level Care: 6 children were present upstairs with a caregiver and vendor for a specialized class without Fire Marshal approval. Note: this was corrected at inspection when the director moved the group of children downstairs.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Fire Inspection Report, Including Written Approval for Above/Below Ground Level Care (26 TAC §746.801(11))

occurrences.finding: Pest Extermination: 1 active ant bed is present on the playground.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Pest Extermination (26 TAC §746.3427)

occurrences.finding: Documentation PEDIATRIAC CPR-1st aid original certificate on file at center or copy available if licensing requests: 2 out of 8 staff were missing the original certificate for pediatric CPR/first aid.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documentation PEDIATRIAC CPR-1st aid original certificate on file at center or copy available if licensing requests (26 TAC §746.1329(c)(2))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Emergency Contact: During review of record keeping 6 out of 10 records evaluated did not include the address for the emergency contact as required.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Emergency Contact (26 TAC §746.605(6))

occurrences.finding: Prohibited Punishments - Withholding Active Play: During the inspection I observed a caregiver withholding active play for two children in care. The children's  classrooms outdoor time was ending by the time they were going outside.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Prohibited Punishments - Withholding Active Play (26 TAC §746.2805(9))

occurrences.finding: Medication No Longer Used: During the inpsection the operation was found to have 3 expired epi-pens for children with food allergies and an expired inhaler for a child in care.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Medication No Longer Used (26 TAC §746.3809)

occurrences.finding: Written Operational Policies - Promotion of Physical Activity: During review of administration the center's operational policies did not include promotion of Physical activity as requied by minimum standards.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Operational Policies - Promotion of Physical Activity (26 TAC §746.501(a)(18))

occurrences.finding: Safety - Electrical Outlets Covered: During the inspection I oberved 2 electrical outlets uncovered
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Electrical Outlets Covered (26 TAC §746.3701(1))

occurrences.finding: Personal use of electronic devices, such as cell phones, MP3 players, tablets, and video games: During the walkthrough I oberserved a caregiver on their phone when they were supposed to be supervising children during naptime.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Personal use of electronic devices, such as cell phones, MP3 players, tablets, and video games (26 TAC §746.1203(3)(D))

occurrences.finding: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards: During the walkthrough of the outdoor play area I oberved three broken fence boards, a wooden bench with a nail exposed, a rubber hose covering wire sticking out of the ground    The caregiver in charge hammered the exposed nail flat during the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards (26 TAC §746.3701)

occurrences.finding: Food Allergy Emergency Plan Signed by Parents and Health Care Professional: During review of safety the opeation did not have an emergency plan signed by parents and health care professional for two children with  diagnosed food allergies.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Food Allergy Emergency Plan Signed by Parents and Health Care Professional (26 TAC §746.3819)

occurrences.finding: Safety - Electrical Outlets Covered: I observed 4 electrical outlets that were not covered as required.    This was corrected when the director replaced the plug covers.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Electrical Outlets Covered (26 TAC §746.3701(1))

occurrences.finding: Hand Sanitizer - Stored Out of Child's Reach When Not in Use: During my walkthrough I observed a bottle of sanitizer accessible to children in care.    This was corrected when the caregiver removed the bottle of sanitizer.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Hand Sanitizer - Stored Out of Child's Reach When Not in Use (26 TAC §746.3420(5))

occurrences.finding: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards: During the walkthrough I observed two water hoses that were left out unraveled on the playground, I observed two broken fence boards as well as one board that was not secured. I observed a  broken gate as well as a broken bench that appears to cover a concrete slab. I observed broken wooden barriers with rod iron exposed.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards (26 TAC §746.3701)

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Immunizations: During review of records 1 out of 8 evaluated did not have current immunizations.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Immunizations (26 TAC §746.603(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Employee Handwashing After Diapering a Child: During the walkthrough I observed a caregiver change their gloves and proceeded to change another child's diaper without washing their hands.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Employee Handwashing After Diapering a Child (26 TAC §746.3415(4))

occurrences.finding: Installation and Maintenance of Loose-fill Surfacing - Proper Depth Maintained: The operation has failed to maintain their loose fill surfacing at a proper depth.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Installation and Maintenance of Loose-fill Surfacing - Proper Depth Maintained (26 TAC §746.4907(d))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know Group Responsible For: During the walkthrough of the toddler class I had a caregiver state they were caring for 15 children when I observed 16 children present. During the walkthrough of the older toddler classroom a caregiver stated they were caring for 17 children when I observed 18 children present.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know Group Responsible For (26 TAC §746.1203(2))

occurrences.finding: Maximum Group Size 13 or More Children: During the follow up inspection completed one classroom is out of ratio by 2 children. The specified age group is 4 year old classroom with 37 children and two caregivers at nap time.     Note: This was corrected when two children were moved to a different classroom.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maximum Group Size 13 or More Children (26 TAC §746.1609)

occurrences.finding: Incident/Illness Report Form Shared with Parent: It was found that the incident report was not signed by the child's parents. The incident occurred on 09/20/2021.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Incident/Illness Report Form Shared with Parent (26 TAC §746.707)

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers- Supervision of Children: It was found that on 09/20/2021 a child was bitten multiple times on the face and the caregivers were unaware of how the incident occurred.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Supervision of Children (26 TAC §746.1203(4))
